description: A clear plastic sports drink bottle with an orange cap sits on the table in front of both hands. The left hand reaches in from the left to grasp the bottle and tip it slightly onto its side, while the right hand moves in from the right to grip the cap and twist it counterclockwise; the right hand then lifts the loosened cap off and sets it down on the tabletop to the right as the left hand steadies the now-open bottle upright.
